subject.title: feat: Discord channel-per-agent binding display in Gateway UI (ZZ-20260311-005)

question: Which read-only Gateway/UI surface should expose configured route and ACP bindings for the selected-agent Channels panel?
rationale: The requested behavior adds a new core Gateway protocol namespace and UI read model, while current code already has binding helpers and existing config/channel surfaces that could also own the data.

options.title: Approve a normalized binding read model
options.body: Define a stable read-only binding list contract, whether named routing.list or placed under an existing namespace, then review the linked implementation against that contract.

options.title: Use the existing config read surface
options.body: Have the UI derive the display from config.get/current config data, avoiding a new RPC but coupling the panel to raw config shape.

options.title: Defer the display
options.body: Keep binding visibility in config/docs for now and pause or close the linked implementation until a broader Control UI routing plan exists.

recommendation.title: Approve a normalized binding read model
recommendation.body: Define a stable read-only binding list contract, whether named routing.list or placed under an existing namespace, then review the linked implementation against that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main ownership spans the present Control UI/Gateway/config files affected by the API placement decision.
